title: terrain
summary: MSUI's OpenGL world pipeline covers per-tile ADT splat terrain, height queries, MCLQ liquid with depth fade and submerged tint, foliage, WMO/doodad rendering, and authored WoW lighting. Weather packet/audio state is now present, but Benilla's ramped storm-light/fog channels and rain/snow/sand precipitation pools do not yet have MSUI render counterparts.

openItems.text: SMSG_WEATHER visual presentation remains: exact dual ~10-second effect/sky ramps, storm lighting/fog blend, outdoor/interior visibility gate, and rain/snow/sand precipitation/mist pools. Packet decode and outdoor-only weather ambience are implemented.
